tips: Here I'll just tell you what you can do and what the enemy can do. For more detailed information, visit "Detailed matchups".

You can use W to prevent his W from hitting you or to break the chain. He can run away from you with R, so one shot him faster. Use E on him to evade the edge of his Q. Also, if you have a good reaction, you can interrupt his E with R.

She can hit you with E and Q during your E. She is also stronger during her W, so back off. You should conduct short trades E+W+Q, then you can go all in. If you have a reaction, then you can stop her E and R with R, then she will not run away from you and will die.
So that he does not hit you Q, do not stand behind the minions. It all depends on his E. You need to interrupt it either with the body, either W or R. Then you will defeat him!
She can stop your E with W. She can also use E to reduce your damage. Use W to evade her W, also clone will be beaten by her E. You can stop her Q with R.
You can trade after her Q+E combo. Use W to evade her E or R.
She can use W to poke you, so, use E on her during it to trade and evade her W. Try to trade after her Q. Use W to evade her E.
She can use W and R during your E, so she'll kill you. Kill her on lvl 2 or 3. After lvl 6 wait for her mistakes and all in.
He can use W during your E. Use W to evade his Q. Trade after his Q. Use long trades.
He can use E to interrrupt your E. He can heal from your clone with Q. Use W/E to evade his Q. Play around short trades.
He can heal from your clone with Q and W. Stay behind minions to evade his Q and try evade his E! Don't try to all in him.
She can use W during your E, Also she can poke you with Q. Use W behind her during her W. Play around long trades. You can interrupt her Q with R.
He can easily poke you with Q and zone with E, You have to destroy his E with AA+Q. Use W to make his Passive AA on clone. Use Ignite before his W to reduce his healing. Play around long trades.
His W makes your short trades useless. Use W to evade his E. Don't fight with him pre lvl 6, just poke. After lvl 6, all in him or don't fight, because his passive is imbalanced.
He can easily kite you. Abuse bushes for trading. You can interrupt his E with R.
His E counters you. Buy Ravenous Hydra and keep farming.
Use W to block his AAs. You can interrupt his E with R. Just all in him!
Use W to evade her Q. One shot her after lvl 6. You can use R to interrupt her E.
Use W to evade his E. After lvl 6 you can just one shot him with a combo.
This is my personal permaban, since even if you win the lane, 0 6 Illaoi will one shot you after. She can abuse your W to heal from it. Use W to evade her E and then all in her.
Use W to dodge her E. Don't fight with her if she has stacked passive.
He can ignore your Q with E. He can zone you from farming with Q. Use W to evade his E. Stay in bush and get exp. You can all in him after lvl 6.
You can't initiate because of his E. I advise you to farm. all in if he spend E.
He can poke you with E+Q combo. Use W to evade his W. Trade after his Q. You can't kill him after 6, but if he uses R - then you kill him easily.
Just all in her.
Stay behind minions to ebade her Q. She's very tanky, wait for lvl 6 and kill her. You can use W to evade her Q.
You have to kill her before lvl 6. Keep freezing and abuse her weakness.
Use W to evade his W. Use R to interrupt his R. You can easily kill him!
You can use W to evade his Q. He can easily trade with you, don't use E until he spends Q! Use W to evade his R.
He can easily trade with you, don't use E until he spends Q+W! Use W to evade his combo or R.

He is much stronger than you, so just wait for the moment when he spends his abilities on minions, then you can go to trade. After 6 you can't go all in because of his R. Use R to interrupt his Q or W.
She can easily poke and kite you. You can use R to interrupt her W. I advise you to afk farm until lvl 6, After lvl 6 you can kill her.
Unplayable, his abilities counter you. Afk farm.
He can use Q to interrupt your E. Trade after his Q. Don't approach the bushes. You overscale him.
He can use Q and E during your E. Use E+AA+Q+W combo for short trades. Use W to evade his Q. You can kill him after lvl 6 if he's low hp and you're high hp.
You can use R to interrupt her W and E. She's easy to kill.
Don't stay in his E. Keep freezing and kill him easily!
She can use E during your E. She'll use W after your E. You can't initiate, you're useless. Try to farm.
Just kill her, xd)
He can poke you with Q. Use W to evade his Q. Don't fight him until lvl 6. After lvl 6 you can one shot him.
He can use his abilities during your E. Use R to interrupt his E or R. Try to farm, you overscale him.
He'll poke you with Q. He'll use W during your E. He'll use E when you're going to trade. Wait for lvl 6 and try to interrupt his W with R, then you can kill him.

She will use E during your E, so don't use that to approach, use W for that. Wait for her to spend Passive on a minion so as not to be poked. After 6, use R to interrupt her E or R, and also W to evade her R.
She can use E to interrupt your E. Use R to interrupt her E and kill her!
He can use Q yo interrupt your E. You can't kill him, he can't kill you, Just farm.
He's just stronger than you. Try to farm and kill him if he dives you. You can interrupt his E with R.
Don't approach the bushes. Wait for lvl 6 and kill him. You can use R to interrupt his jumping.
This matchup depends entirely on the mechanical skills of the players. Play around cooldowns, up to 6 do not be exposed. After 6, use R to interrupt her Q and then you win.

He has more damage and survivability. He'll push the wave towards you and poke you with Q and E, so, try to dodge it and farm. Wait for lvl 6 and realize your power, kill him, if he hasn't abilities! Without R, you are useless against him, so wait for R and kill him again!
Just kill him. Use R to interrupt his R.
You can't beat her. She'll use Q to interrupt your E. Try to farm. Use R to interrupt her Q.
Hold W to evade his W and win!
He's very annoying, place pink ward and be there to farm.
He can use W to block your damage. Use R to interrupt his E or R. Farm.
Try to dodge her E and farm, you can't kill her.
Just kill him. Don't chase him!
Use W to evade his Q. Freeze the lane and kill him.
He has a lot of damage. Use W to evade his E. One shot him on lvl 6.
He has a lot of damage. Use W to evade his E. Use R to interrupt his E. One shot him on lvl 6.
Use W to evade his Q or W. Use R to interrupt his W. Just farm, you can't kill him.
His Q makes your Q useless. Wait for lvl 6 and kill him!
Try to farm. You can't kill him if he has R. Poke him and kill then.
You have to kill him until lvl 6. After lvl 6 just poke him and farm. Use R to interrupt his E.
He's very tanky and annoying, buy Ravenous Hydra and just farm.
He can use E during your E. Use W to evade his E or R. Use R to interrupt his E.
She can use E to interrupt your E. Wait for lvl 6 and all in her.
He can heal from your clone with Q. All in him or die!
He has a lot of damage with combo, so afk farm.
You can't damage him (because of his healing), just try to farm.
He can use E on your clone. Use W to evade his Q. Use R to interrupt his E and one shot him. He can kite you with E, then he'll kill you.
Use W to evade his Q. You can't kill him because he can easily evade your damage with Q/W/E/R (XD, with any ability!).
Use W to evade his E and then go all in.
Use W to evade his E. Use R to interrupt his E.
